correctness.rationale: With one jumble and max target length four, J4(00110) contains precisely the 10 four-letter targets allowed by 3 zeros and 2 ones. Positive 0001 and 0011 membership and absent 0000 and 0111 force any globally equivalent source to have exactly three zeros and two ones, regardless of initial length. Exhausting ten anagrams yields the class {00110,01001,01010,01100,10010}; five other words have five distinct missing-target patterns and are singleton classes. All ten have the same shorter-layer profile; I independently recomputed J_t for all 10 sources and t=0..4 and obtained six classes, with no infinite inference from finite search.

value.rationale: Beyond the already answered general existence question, the binary alphabet restriction and complete partition of the natural smallest nontrivial 3:2 Parikh family provide a concrete exact word-combinatorics invariant: all ten words partition into a 5-class plus five singletons under the precisely specified relation. The binary witness demonstrates intermediate classes without a third letter, unlike the earlier ternary example, making the exact classification independently useful; no claim of minimal word length across all binary words is made.

limitations: One binary alphabet composition (3,2) and k=4,ell=1 only; no classification of all lengths, no minimality assertion.
